svg.title: Blueprint 12: Source-Free Deployment Contract, Mount Guards & Multi-Tier Backup
svg.desc: Modern Athenaeum deployment and disaster recovery diagram for iqoqo v1.2.0 showing Path A Host Checkout and Path B Source-Free DEPLOY_DIR converging into shared v1.2.0 stdin secret reconciliation, non-root UID 10001/10002 mount guards, Crimson production destructive locks, and the 4-stage cloud_backup.sh / native boto3 S3Service DR pipeline.
svg.text: Blueprint 12: Source-Free Deployment Contract, Mount Guards & Multi-Tier Backup
Dual Deploy Paths • v1.2.0 Stdin Secret Reconciliation • UID 10001/10002 Guards • Dual rclone / Native S3Service DR

g.text: • Runs directly from repository checkout (app/, frontend/, tests/)
Shares identical mount validation & secret hardening guards with Path B
• ZERO source code checkouts — real files only (no external symlinks)
make deploy-validate • make deploy-sync • make deploy-verify
Protects data/, exports/, covers/, gallery/; prunes excess .env.bak.* snapshots
